physical.notes: Printed switch-matrix drive column 3, return row 1, cell 'Trough #1'; ROM switch-test text 'TROUGH JAM'. Neither copy of the matrix shades a cell or prints an opto legend. The manual's board pages construct this switch as a beam the ball or target breaks, which makes the switch read as made (printed 3-20 to 3-22), so the contact the matrix sees rests closed. Pinned PinMAME's fsGameData inverted-switch mask normalizes this address, so the public state is already normalized and must not be inverted again. One of the LED/phototransistor pairs of the A-18753 outhole trough (Trough 7 IR LED and photo transistor boards on the A-15576 7-opto switch board, column 3 rows 1-5). The printed matrix and switch list name 31-34 'Trough #1-#4' and 35 'Trough Jam'; the ROM's switch table, pinned fs.c's simulator defines and the retained script (InitSwitches 32-35) all put Trough Jam on 31 and Trough 1-4 on 32-35, which is recorded. The retained script's SolRelease pulses 31 on every trough eject, a table stand-in rather than a jam. Projected onto the trough exit kicker BallRelease: the retained table models no trough opto objects (its cvpmTrough holds the balls virtually and exits them at BallRelease), so the five trough optos share the exit position.

mechanisms.behavior: Four balls rest in the A-18753 outhole trough on the optos 32 (Trough 1, at the eject end) to 35 (Trough 4); 31 (Trough Jam) is a fifth LED/phototransistor pair. The pairs sit on the Trough 7 IR LED and photo transistor boards, wired through the A-15576 7-opto switch board (column 3, rows 1-5); a ball breaks the beam and the switch reads made, and PinMAME normalizes all five. Solenoid 1 (AE-26-1500) kicks the ball on 32 into the shooter lane. The retained script holds the balls in a cvpmTrough, exits them at BallRelease and pulses 31 with every eject. The T.15 Empty Balls Test clears every ball from the trough and the lock-up devices.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: A ball served from the trough rests on Shooter Lane (15). The ROM fires solenoid 2 (A-14525 kicker bracket, AE-23-800) to launch it when the player presses the cabinet Launch button (11), or automatically after adjustment A.2 05 Seconds Before Autofire (printed range 10-40 seconds, factory default printed 50). Adjustment A.2 17 Flipper Plunger lets the right flipper button launch the ball when the launch button is broken. There is no manual plunger; the retained script fires its plunger AutoPlunger.
mechanisms.label: Shooter lane and autoplunger

mechanisms.behavior: A ball entering the popper at the rear left is seen by its opto (36, on the trough's 7-opto switch board) and popped up by solenoid 4 (AE-23-800) of the A-15769-1 Ball Popper & Opto Assembly. Per the shot maps, the upper lanes feed the popper when MACHINE TIME, START MULTI-BALL or BRONTO CRANE is lit. The retained script ejects it with a cvpmSaucer on Kicker36 under the comment 'Bronto/Machine VUK'.
mechanisms.label: Top popper

mechanisms.behavior: A-17978 bracket assembly in the upper left corner, mounted on the A-18823 back panel: the A-18135 wheel turned by the 14-7999 motor (solenoid 23, fed +12V through the A-15542 Motor EMI board), the A-18566 ramp, an A-11541 socket and bulb with its flasher cable beside the Boulder Machine Flasher (24), and the A-19098 ball popper exit switch (25). A ball reaches it from the upper right lane past Machine Enter (76, the ROM's MACHINE ENTER) and leaves past Machine Exit (25). The rules call it the Rock Slicer Machine: shooting the lit Dicta-Bird target starts its MACHINE TIME scoring round. The T.14 Machine Test runs the motor ('running' or 'off'). The retained script runs it as a clockwise cvpmTurnTable on ttMachineTrigger and briefly blocks the exit at some wheel angles to keep the ball spinning; wheel speed and timing are table-owned. G.I. string 1 (Machine Lighting) lights it.
mechanisms.label: Boulder Machine

positions.description: Machine Enter rollover at the end of the upper right lane.
positions.label: Ball entering

mechanisms.behavior: A-16032-1 3-bank drop target assembly on the left: three targets B (47, rear), E (46) and D (45, front), each read by an opto on the A-13609 drop target board, which PinMAME normalizes; solenoid 5 (AE-26-1200) raises all three through the reset plate. The rules: completing B-E-D adds a CONCRETE letter, BEDROCK WATER BUFFALOS scores flashing targets, and completing both banks during the BEDROCK mystery mode awards 100 million.
mechanisms.label: B-E-D 3-bank drop targets

mechanisms.behavior: A-18188 4-bank drop target assembly in the centre, angled from the rear left to the front right: R (41), O (42), C (43) and K (44), each read by an opto on the A-19103 drop target board, which PinMAME normalizes; solenoid 6 (AE-24-900) raises the bank through its A-13453 reset plate. Completing R-O-C-K adds a CONCRETE letter.
mechanisms.label: R-O-C-K 4-bank drop targets

mechanisms.behavior: A-17932 Diverter Assembly: an AE-27-1200 coil lifting a post on the A-17986 bell armature at the rear, beside the popper. No switch senses it. The retained script makes its DiverterPost collidable only while the coil is on.
mechanisms.label: Top diverter post

mechanisms.behavior: A-18369 Diverter Assembly (back diverter 01-12803 on the A-18368 bell armature, AE-27-1200 coil) on the A-18823 Back Panel Assembly, which also carries the 03-9131 back panel diverter guide, the ball-gate bracket and the Boulder Machine. The ROM calls it BACKPANEL DIVRTR. No switch senses it. The retained script swings a flipper object, BrontoDiverter, to its end while the coil is on.
mechanisms.label: Back panel diverter

mechanisms.behavior: A-18078 Diverter Assembly on the left side: an AE-28-1500 coil and A-6306-2 bell armature under the A-18079 Dicta-Bird perch mounting bracket, beside the Dicta-Bird target (56). Per the shot maps, the lit target starts MACHINE TIME, lights BARNEY'S JOB CHANGE or starts SEARCH AND RESCUE. The retained script animates the figure by tilting its Dictabird primitive while the coil is on; the figure's travel is table-owned.
mechanisms.label: Dicta-Bird

mechanisms.behavior: A-19097-2 (left) and A-19097-1 (right) Diverter Assemblies (AE-27-1200, A-19096 bell armature) at the top of the outlane and return lane dividers, just below the Drain Save lamps (41). The rules: completing either side 3-bank lights DRAIN SAVE for a timed period (adjustment A.2 10, factory 5 seconds). The ROM's coil test calls them L. RMP. DIVERTER and R. RMP. DIVERTER. No switch senses them. While each coil is on the retained script moves its post and makes its diverter primitive non-collidable.
mechanisms.label: Lower left and right diverters (drain save)

mechanisms.behavior: Two A-17796 Ball Gate Actuator Assemblies (A-14406 coil, A-11146 armature, A-6892 frame and eyelet) at the rear, on the Fliptronic upper-left circuit: the right gate on its power transistor (35) and the left gate on its hold transistor (36). No switch senses either gate. The retained script makes its Gate2 (right) and Gate4 (left) non-collidable while the coil is on, so the ball passes.
mechanisms.label: Left and right up/down gates

mechanisms.behavior: Three A-9415-2 jet bumpers (AE-26-1200) below the D-I-G rollovers: the top left jet (coil 11, switch 63), the bottom jet (coil 12, switch 65) and the top right jet (coil 13, switch 64), as the ROM's coil and switch tables and pinned fs.c's simulator pair them.
mechanisms.label: Three jet bumpers

mechanisms.behavior: B-9362-L-2 (left, coil 10) and B-9362-R-3 (right, coil 9) slingshot assemblies (AE-26-1200); each carries a kick switch (SW-1A-114) and a score switch (SW-1A-120) on one address.
mechanisms.label: Left and right slingshots

mechanisms.behavior: Lower right and upper right (A-15849-R-2) and lower left (A-15849-L-2) Fliptronic flippers with FL-11629 blue coils and separate power and hold windings, each with an end-of-stroke leaf switch (111, 113, 115). The left cabinet button's opto is 114; the right cabinet button's opto board breaks both 112 and 116, so it fires the lower and upper right flippers together. The ROM energizes both windings on the button and drops the power winding when the end-of-stroke closes. The retained script's SolRFlipper swings both right flippers.
mechanisms.label: Three flippers

mechanisms.behavior: Solenoid 7 fires the B-10686-1 knocker (AE-23-800), wired through the backbox connections and not drawn on the playfield.
mechanisms.label: Knocker
